citation.verbatim: A total of 119,018,767 shares of Monster's common stock were validly tendered and not validly withdrawn at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share or as purchase price tenders. Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion. Because the number of shares tendered would have exceeded the aggregate purchase price of the tender offer, shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

D1.decision: Apply the full odd-lot acceptance to all 87 shares validly tendered by expiration; make no new election after expiration, book gross proceeds of 4611, and hold only the net cash release and fee posting pending the missing Letter of Transmittal.

actions.action: Book final acceptance of the tendered MNST shares and the gross cash receivable
